source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the LED control
1. Turn on and check UID is light as expected
2. Turn of and cehck UID is not light as expected

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify the intended chassis System Identify/UID LED can be turned on and off from the BMC WebUI LED control, management readback matches each state, the correct physical LED visibly follows, and the original approved baseline is restored.
original_method: Identify the exact chassis and physical UID LED, capture WebUI/API and physical baseline, obtain approval, set On once through the source WebUI or an approved equivalent, verify management state and timestamped physical appearance, set Off or restore the original state once, verify both surfaces again, and prove no power/fault LED changed.
manual_activity: An owner approves the exact chassis/LED mapping, control, duration and restore state. A physical operator or approved camera must identify the actual LED for On and Off; management writes/readbacks may be automated after point-of-action approval, and the human owns the verdict.
required_inputs: UID LED physical location and expected color/mode
Baseline state and bounded On duration
safety_requirements: Do not clear BMC/SEL logs; retain the indicator-control audit trail.
Do not assume `/Chassis/system`, use `curl -k` or expose credentials; discover and validate the exact resource/action or preserve the WebUI path.
Do not confuse UID with power, status or fault LEDs; correlate chassis identity and physical location before writing.
Obtain point-of-action approval, issue each On/Off write once and do not automatically retry.
Management readback cannot replace physical observation, and physical observation alone cannot prove the correct control path.
Stop on wrong LED, unexpected blink/color, failed readback or persistent state; restore the approved baseline through the validated method and escalate rather than guessing.
Verify no host power state or unrelated indicator changed.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target/resource/enum, baseline, physical mapping, observer, protected access, duration and recovery.
Collect timestamped WebUI/API and physical baseline without clearing logs.
After approval, set UID On once, capture response/readback/audit and physical appearance.
Set Off or restore baseline once and verify management plus physical state.
Prove no other LED/power state changed and return evidence without DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the chassis/UID mapping, supported control and any WebUI-to-Redfish override equivalence.
Approve baseline, On duration, physical evidence, point-of-action writes and recovery.
Review correlated On/Off/restore evidence and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The proposed IndicatorLED write/read concept fits only if vendor schema confirms the resource and enum. It lacks an exact command, trusted access, baseline/duration, audit and restoration details; its HTTP state still cannot prove the correct physical LED changed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the validated BMC WebUI control or approved protected Redfish action for the exact chassis UID state, pair every write with readback/audit and physical observation, and restore the captured baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs path, On and Off checkpoints, UID Criteria, no Script/Bundle and 2/0-minute estimates remain preserved; feasibility of two minutes is a Project readiness issue.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Correlate the exact UID control, management state and physical chassis LED through baseline-On-Off/restore with one approved write per transition.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, WebUI build and selected Redfish/vendor schema.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor chassis LED mapping and Project rack-identification policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target/schema validation, protected access, audit, duration, separate physical evidence and deterministic restoration while retaining WebUI functional coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Redfish is a Project override unless WebUI equivalence is approved; API readback cannot replace physical visibility, and a read-only state check cannot replace toggling.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: LED mapping/control, observer, baseline/duration and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong or persistent indicator can misidentify equipment and confuse service personnel.

project_override_considerations: Redfish/vendor control may replace WebUI only when the original method, actual method, reason, engineer approval, On/Off/readback/physical equivalence and uncovered UI coverage are recorded. New tools are not blocked merely because they are absent from an old list.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/chassis/firmware/WebUI identity, validated control/enum, UID physical map and timestamped baseline
On write response/audit and management readback paired with physical location/color/mode observation
Off/restore write response/audit and management readback paired with physical baseline confirmation
Proof the host power and unrelated fault/status LEDs did not change
Preserved logs, wrong-state recovery if needed and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently describe System Identify/UID LED On and Off behavior. Missing schema, duration and evidence details are readiness gaps, not competing Master purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The UID target and On/Off operation are identifiable. Project/vendor inputs can supply the exact mapping and method, so this is hybrid execution readiness rather than permanent BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the hybrid conclusion but makes the unspecified Redfish suggestion conditional and adds exact target, protected access, physical correlation, audit and restore requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with its classification and safety lifecycle while explicitly preserving WebUI coverage and limiting API override claims.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Corrects the execution boundary from generic DUT-host automation to BMC control plus independent physical chassis observation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Separates UID signaling from the preceding host power status and following system inventory.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No invalid draft exists for this exact source identity.

review_improvement: Makes the physical and management checkpoints independently auditable, prevents wrong-LED writes and guarantees restoration without lowering the source's functional coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: An Identify/UID LED is an operator-facing state: a successful write or returned enum can be stale or mapped to the wrong chassis, while a visual flash could come from a different control. Correct evidence therefore requires immutable target mapping, synchronized management and physical observations for both transitions, and a verified restore because leaving UID asserted creates operational confusion.
